subject: gk
question: The founder of Yes Bank is:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rana Kapoor.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Yes, Bank is an Indian bank headquartered in Mumbai, India, **and was** founded by Rana Kapoor and Ashok Kapur in 2004.**
 
• **Rana Kapoor (born 9 September 1957) is an Indian former banker** **who was the managing director and CEO of Yes Bank, an Indian private sector bank.**
 
• **On 5 March 2020, in an attempt to avoid the collapse of the bank,** which had an excessive amount of bad loans,** the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) took control of it.**
 
• **RBI later reconstructed the board and named Prashant Kumar, former chief financial officer and deputy managing director of State Bank of India, as MD & CEO of Yes Bank, along with Sunil Mehta, former non-executive chairman of Punjab National Bank, as Yes Bank’s non-executive chairman.**
 
• **As of June 2022, Yes Bank is an associate of State Bank of India which has a 30% stake in the company.**
 
• **YES BANK** stands for **Youth Enterprise Scheme Bank.**
